it: \bCome hai fatto a diventare così forte?

id: \bI want to follow tradition and enter the Clubsplosion with a Fighting type.
en: \bI want to follow tradition and enter the Clubsplosion with a Fighting type.
it: \bVoglio seguire la tradizione e partecipare al Clubsplosion con un tipo Lotta.

id: \bMaybe I'll just use a flying type and sweep.
en: \bMaybe I'll just use a flying type and sweep.
it: \bO magari uso un tipo Volante e li spazzo via tutti.

id: \bYou going to visit the tower? Tough trainers are there.
en: \bYou going to visit the tower? Tough trainers are there.
it: \bVai a visitare la torre? Lì ci sono Allenatori tosti.
\rUn po' di allenamento mi farebbe comodo.

id: \bYou ready for a real fight. Oh, right, I'm out of Pokémon.
en: \bYou ready for a real fight. Oh, right, I'm out of Pokémon.
it: \bSei pronto per uno scontro vero? Ah, già, ho finito i Pokémon.

id: \bThe Clubsplosion is going to start soon. How dare you say you can miss it. A young trainer like you should be thrilled to enter.
en: \bThe Clubsplosion is going to start soon. How dare you say you can miss it. A young trainer like you should be thrilled to enter.
it: \bIl Clubsplosion sta per cominciare. Come osi dire che puoi perdertelo? Un giovane Allenatore come te dovrebbe non vedere l'ora di partecipare.

id: \bNo excuses. Go do it right now.
en: \bNo excuses. Go do it right now.

id: \bThey prefer fighting types there, but any can enter.
en: \bThey prefer fighting types there, but any can enter.
it: \bLì preferiscono i tipi Lotta, ma chiunque può partecipare.

id: \bAre you prepared to traverse the mountain?
en: \bAre you prepared to traverse the mountain?

id: \bI never lose, how did you do it?
en: \bI never lose, how did you do it?
it: \bIo non perdo mai, come hai fatto?
